positions.as_written: Treat it as a complex and name the component when discussing injury or reconstruction.
Expect its loss to remove an active and a passive restraint in the same direction.
Treat the complex as the structure that makes anatomic corner reconstruction a three component operation: the lateral collateral, the popliteus tendon and the popliteofibular ligament.
